verdict.rationale: Featurebase is fundamentally a feedback/feature-request management tool, so a central searchable repository for requests is core to its category, but the evidence pack only mentions integrations, AI declutter features, and editor/changelog capabilities without directly describing a unified searchable repository combining colleague and customer feedback. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a unified search interface, evidence of merging internal (colleague) and external (customer) submissions into one repository, and any screenshots/hands-on confirmation of search functionality across feedback sources.
